summary: The registrant, Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc., filed an 8-K reporting the acceptance by the Nevada Secretary of State of a Certificate of Amendment that reduces authorized common stock from 27.5 billion to 12.0 billion shares (a 15.5 billion share decrease), effective July 15, 2026. The amendment was previously approved by the board and majority shareholder on March 19, 2026, and disclosed in preliminary and definitive Schedule 14C filings. No price, premium, consideration, or other deal terms are involved. This is a routine charter amendment, not a special situation.
